decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed single-storey rear extension, due to its due to its size, position and excessive combined depth, would represent an obtrusive and un-neighbourly development, which would harm the living conditions of adjoining occupiers, by reason of unacceptable enclosure and loss of light and outlook, and when taken with the existing and proposed extensions at the site, would fail to be subordinate, and would detract from the original character of the house, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1, H.6.4 and the Council's Residential Extensions Guidelines (October 2003).

Condition : 2 - The proposed detached block of four garages, due to its excessive height, bulk, footprint, and proximity to the rear boundary, would represent an incongruous and overbearing development, which would be detrimental to the outlook of neighbouring occupiers, and would be out of character with the existing house and the pattern of development in the area, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1, H.6.4 and the Council's Residential Extensions Guidelines (October 2003).

Condition : 3 - The proposal, due to the excessive number of on site parking spaces, would be likely to give rise to conditions prejudicial to the free flow of traffic and highway safety in this cul-de-sac, and would be likely to give rise to an unacceptable increase in vehicular activity and associated noise and disturbance at the property, harmful to neighbours' living conditions, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1, H.6.4 and the Council's Residential Extensions Guidelines (October 2003).
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and detached single storey building comprising four garages to rear of house.
